species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 52°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 24–28 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 35 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 55 ft, so fish stay above it.
Northwest wind at 10 mph pushes bait onto the southeast shore: try the wind-blown banks.
